description: opendata.gov.jo is an open data portal listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Jordan (Open Government Data Portal, Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship). The Open Government Data Portal of Jordan (opendata.gov.jo) is run by the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship on CKAN. It lists about 3,800 data sets in Arabic and English from more than 70 ministries, regulators and public companies. Coverage: Jordan. 3,768 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 48 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
